_comment: 🔮️ This subset's own contribution to the repository test platform: `ruststep` 0.4 registered as the real ISO 10303-21 reader for stdio.ifc 2x3/✳️any's exhaustive Ifc2x3Mutation vocabulary, the mutation catalog it is measured against, and the tolerant structural comparison profile a re-serialized IFC2X3 exchange structure needs against an independently parsed one. IFC2X3 is physically ISO 10303-21 (STEP physical file) syntax under a different EXPRESS schema -- ruststep parses it exactly as it parses the sibling `step/🔖️ap214/✳️any` subset, which already established this exact §6 situation this wave.

oracles.rationale: ruststep 0.4 is a real, actively-maintained ISO 10303-21/-11 (EXPRESS) parser for Rust, already linked and registered for the sibling `step/🔖️ap214/✳️any` subset this wave -- confirmed here by reading its own source again (~/.cargo/registry/src/.../ruststep-0.4.0): `ast::Exchange`/`ast::DataSection`/`ast::Record`/`ast::Parameter`/`ast::EntityInstance` all implement `FromStr` over the real Part-21 clear-text grammar (multi-line records, nested lists, typed/complex instances, `$`/`*`/`.ENUM.`/`#ref` tokens), and IFC2X3 is physically identical ISO 10303-21 syntax to STEP AP214 under a different EXPRESS schema (`FILE_SCHEMA(('IFC2X3'))` in place of `FILE_SCHEMA(('AUTOMOTIVE_DESIGN'))`) -- verified against this subset's own real fixture (3464 real entities, a genuine forward-reference-closed subset of a real 21 MB IFC2X3 building model, parsed with zero errors). It has NO writer at all: `ast::ser::to_record` only builds a `Record` from an already-typed Rust struct, and grepping the whole crate source for `Display`/`fmt::Formatter` impls on `Exchange`/`DataSection`/`Record`/`Parameter` finds none -- there is no `to_string`/serialize path back to Part-21 text anywhere in the crate. Per the fleet brief's §6, this rules out `@mode-differential`: ruststep cannot be a second PRODUCER of mutated bytes to diff against. It is registered here strictly as the INDEPENDENT READER role instead -- every real mutation this subset's own oracle dispatcher (`../🧪️oracle/🦀️component.rs`) performs (via ruststep's real parse plus this module's own from-scratch Part-21 writer, since none exists to reuse and this subset's own production `step::engine::part21` writer must not be used as an oracle -- that would compare this repository's implementation against itself) is read back through a FRESH, independent `ruststep::ast::Exchange::from_str` call before being projected onto `semantic-ifc-v1`, and the identity round trip is checked the same way. This is real third-party evidence about the STRUCTURE of the result (entity graph shape, header schema, argument values as ruststep's own parser sees them), even though it cannot discharge a byte-level differential claim.

comparisonProfiles.description: IFC2X3 (ISO 10303-21 physical file under the IFC2X3 EXPRESS schema) exchange structures compared by declared FILE_SCHEMA and the full id-keyed entity graph (every instance's type name(s) plus positional argument values, complex/multi-type instances kept whole, reals tolerant). Header timestamp, preprocessor/originating-system strings, comment placement and line-wrapping are writer freedom -- the same normative surface `Ifc2x3Diff`/`Ifc2x3Mutation` themselves operate over.
